thread:
jess: Quick ping — PR #4821 updates the onprem deploy to add a KMS-backed secret flow and an egress ACL change for our VPC. Need a quick security sanity check before I schedule the merge window tonight. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/4821 :eyes:
kevin: taking a look now. main concerns: secret scanning, KMS key policy, and that the egress change doesn't open wide ranges. do you have the terraform snippet?
jess: pasted the minimal snippet below, added comments where key policy is referenced:
```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "onprem_secrets" {
  description = "Onprem secret encryption for instance profiles"
  policy = file("./kms/onprem-key-policy.json")
}
resource "aws_network_acl" "onprem_egress" {
  # only allow outbound to our proxy IPs
  egress { protocol = "-1" cidr_block = "10.5.0.0/24" rule_no = 100 action = "allow" }
}
```
jess: also added a short integration test that hits the KMS decrypt endpoint from the onprem instance in CI.
sec-bot: Automated checks: secret-scan OK, dependency-scan OK, policy-lint flagged: onprem-key-policy.json line 12 missing explicit Principal condition.
omar: noted. can you paste the KMS key policy snippet? the bot's lint message usually means explicit service principal detail is missing.
jess: sure — policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::1234567890:role/onprem-role" }, "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"], "Resource": "*" } ]
}
```
jess: I think the bot wants a condition limiting source VPC or IP, or explicit aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp.
kevin: add a Condition block, e.g. "Condition": { "IpAddress": { "aws:SourceIp": "203.0.113.45/32" }} would satisfy lint and tighten scope. also confirm the role ARN is for the onprem instance profile and not a broader role.
omar: on the ACL side — tests OK for 10.5.0.0/24 but make sure we don't accidentally allow 0.0.0.0/0 in the staging terraform var. run `terraform plan -var="env=onprem"` in CI.
jess: CI plan output attached in the PR. it shows only the one egress rule. also I added a quick smoke command you can run from the bastion: `curl -sS --resolve kms.internal:443:10.5.0.12 https://kms.internal/decrypt`
elaine: planning perspective: we need a security ack + PM ack before merging. if sec gives :thumbsup: we can merge in tonight's 22:00 slot. is that workable?
kevin: I can give a formal ack after I update the key policy in the branch (will push a tiny commit). ETA 45m.
omar: I'll re-run the plan and smoke tests after that push.
jess: thanks — I'll wait for your commit then schedule merge slot. tagging the PR with `needs-sec-ack` and `merge-22:00` for tracking. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: Reminder: any KMS changes require post-merge key rotation window note.
jess: noted, will add rotation note to the changelog.
kevin: looks good overall, once policy change is in i'll sign off. :white_check_mark:
omar: agree. one last thing — add a short line in the PR description about why the IP range is limited (for audit). helps reviewers.
jess: done, updated PR description and pushed policy tweak. ping when you re-run checks.
kevin: re-running now. all green. approving. :party:
omar: tests passed locally, CI green. approving.
elaine: great — i'll put merge on tonight's 22:00 cadence. thanks everyone.
